seo_title: The online store setup that actually makes you money instead of costing you
seo_description: Most product sellers pick a platform based on what others use, not what their business actually needs. Here's how to match your store to your products, order volume, and sales channels - so you profit from every sale. Learn more on my blog. #onlinestore #smallbusinesstips #ecommerce

seo_title: From overwhelmed to selling in 4 weeks with this online store setup plan
seo_description: Week 1: foundation and shipping. Week 2: product pages. Week 3: store pages and legal. Week 4: testing and launch. Follow this sequence and you skip the months of struggling with the wrong system. #onlinestoresetup #smallbusiness #ecommercetips
cta: The full breakdown is on my blog - go check it out.

pin_items.title: WEEK 1: FOUNDATION
pin_items.description: Payment setup, shipping zones, rate strategy, and carrier accounts before anything else

pin_items.title: WEEK 2: PRODUCTS
pin_items.description: Photos, descriptions, weights, dimensions, collections - every product page complete

pin_items.title: WEEK 3: PAGES AND LEGAL
pin_items.description: Homepage, about, contact, FAQ, privacy policy, return policy, shipping policy

pin_items.title: WEEK 4: TEST AND LAUNCH
pin_items.description: Real test order with real card, mobile checkout, then announce to your audience
